name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Positional.free_hops_keep_shared_accept
title: Free hops (reject-class reroutes, flips of singly-reached final states) never empty a shared accepting state
statement: Hybrids i = 0..T route each path p to a final state route i p, accepted iff acc i (route i p). Each hop is either (a) a reroute with unchanged acceptance function that keeps every accepted path at its final state and sends every rejected path to a rejecting state, or (b) an acceptance change, with unchanged routing, only at final states reached by at most one path. If the number of final states is smaller than the number of paths accepted at hybrid 0, some path is accepted at hybrid T. In the positional GGH15 witness-encryption candidate with row-partitioned trapdoors (note pq-we-ggh15-row-partitioned-trapdoors), (a) and (b) are the hop types provable from LWE, so a polynomial-width walk to the all-reject hybrid must contain other hops (accept-class splits).
